rationale: David's work shipping production robotics systems (drones at Skycatch, autonomous tractors at Agtonomy) directly intersects with Era's focus on edge intelligence and on-device AI — both are solving the infrastructure gap between prototype and production in physical systems. David's conviction that production robotics requires purpose-built real-time infrastructure complements Era's expertise in sovereign AI and composable open-source stacks, creating potential for exploring how edge inference and real-time comms can solve the ML infrastructure burden David identifies as vastly underestimated in the industry.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Era Qian — you're both building infrastructure for the next generation of autonomous systems, and David's production robotics experience paired with Era's edge AI expertise could unlock ideas around on-device inference for physical robots.
